title: Korean War Chosin Reservoir Marine Vet Interviews 1950
summary: December 8, 1950 interviews with wounded U.S. Marines who participated in the Chosin Reservoir campaign. Listed at the National Archives as "428-NPC-177 SOUND INTERVIEW, 12/08/1950" National Archives description: "U.S. Naval Hospital, Yokosuka, Japan Sound interview of Marine CAPT THEODORE ("PAT") KELLY, who tells a story for Marine 1st LT JOHN YANCEY; it concerns the latter officer's experiences
